newsitem.title: CANADA: Nav Canada closes C$750 million bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Nav Canada closes C$750 million bond issue.

text.p: Nav Canada on Monday said it closed its second public offering of C$750 million in revenue bonds and the offer was fully subscribed.
Nav Canada, a non-profit entity that runs Canada's air traffic control system, had priced the bonds on March 14.

The bonds were issued by Nav Canada to repay part of the C$3 billion bank debt the organization incurred when it bought the air navigation system from the Government of Canada. Nav Canada said about 50 percent of its debt is now in the form of revenue bonds.
